title: codex-lb
brief: A Codex/ChatGPT multiple-account load balancer and proxy with usage tracking, a dashboard, and OpenCode compatibility. Tom: "gonna try first."
details: codex-lb (Soju06) is a load balancer and proxy for multiple ChatGPT/Codex accounts: pool accounts, distribute load, track per-account tokens and costs with 28-day trends, manage per-key API rate limits, and view everything in a password/TOTP-protected dashboard. It exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints for Codex CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the Python SDK, with automatic model sync from upstream. MIT-licensed, deployable via Docker, uvx, or Nix with SQLite by default and optional PostgreSQL; ~3.3k stars.
